menu.help_content:
§l1. Selection§r
Left-click and right-click blocks with the wand to set two corners, or use the Selection page: at my feet, at targeted block, or typed coordinates.

§l2. Fill and replace§r
Pick a block and an area on the Fill page. The block can be the held block, a recent pattern, or typed, e.g. 60%stone,40%andesite.

§l3. Copy and paste§r
Copying remembers where you stand. Walk somewhere else and paste: the build appears at the same relative position.

§l4. Undo§r
Every change can be undone. The main menu has Undo Last Change.

§l5. Commands§r
You can also use /cx <subcommand>, e.g. /cx set stone or /cx undo. When short commands are enabled, you can use /set stone or /undo.

Large operations ask for confirmation first. Progress shows in the action bar and you can cancel at any time.

/cx brush sphere <pattern> [radius] [-h]

help.tool:
/cx tool info shows the block ID, states, and block entity NBT.
/cx tool repl <pattern> samples a block state on left click and replaces one block on right click.
help.mat: /cx mat <pattern> changes the material of the held sphere brush, cylinder brush, or replacement tool.
help.mask: /cx mask [mask] sets the held brush mask. Omit the mask to clear it.
help.range: /cx range <1-128> sets the targeting range of the held brush or tool.
